info.title: AiSEO v1 Client API
info.description:
Programmatic API for keyword ranking data, competitor analysis, and webhook management.

## Authentication

All v1 endpoints require an API key. Create one in the dashboard under Settings > API Keys.

Include it in the Authorization header:
```
Authorization: Bearer kt_live_abc123...
```

## Rate Limits

| Endpoint Type | Limit | Window |
|--------------|-------|--------|
| All v1 endpoints | 100 | 1 minute |

Rate limit headers are included in all responses:
- `X-RateLimit-Limit`: Maximum requests per window
- `X-RateLimit-Remaining`: Requests remaining
- `X-RateLimit-Reset`: Unix timestamp when window resets
- `X-RateLimit-Resource`: Which limit bucket was used

## Schema Versioning

All responses include `X-API-Schema-Version: 1.0` header. We will increment this for breaking changes.

## Errors

All errors follow this format:
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "ERROR_CODE",
    "message": "Human-readable message"
  }
}
```

Common error codes: UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_ERROR, RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED

## Common Tasks

| Task | Endpoint |
|------|----------|
| Get my domain authority (DA) | `GET /api/v1/domain-metrics` |
| Compare my DA to competitors | `GET /api/v1/domain-metrics` (yours) + `GET /api/v1/competitors` (theirs) |
| Side-by-side DA per keyword | `GET /api/v1/keywords/{id}` — includes `userDomainMetrics` |
| SEO score with DA summary | `GET /api/v1/seo-score` |
| Full SERP for a keyword | `GET /api/v1/keywords/{id}` or `GET /api/v1/keywords/{id}/serp` |
| Find link building targets | `GET /api/v1/backlinks/opportunities` |
| Dashboard overview | `GET /api/v1/overview` |
| AI brand visibility | `GET /api/v1/ai-visibility` |
| Run SEO audit on any URL | `POST /api/v1/page-audit` |

get.summary: List tracked keywords (membership) with optional position data
get.description: Returns one row per `user_keywords` membership row. Each row carries a `state` field (`queued` | `active` | `removing`) reflecting lifecycle; position/metric fields are nullable. Use `?state=` to filter; default is `all`. The `counts` block reports per-state counts plus `countedAgainstLimit` (active + queued; `removing` rows do not count against the keyword limit).
x-notes: Query params: limit (max 100), offset, state=queued|active|removing|all, include_history=7|14|30, market=uuid
Sparkline only included when include_history is set
schemaVersion 2 (bumped from 1): every row now carries `state`; previously the response mixed two heterogeneous shapes. Position fields nullable across all rows.
schemaVersion 3 (bumped from 2): every row now carries `url` (the ranking URL for the current position, null when the keyword does not rank) — no more per-keyword detail fan-out to get ranking URLs.

get.summary: List content pages with keyword assignments
get.description: Returns all content pages with keyword assignments. Each keyword reports whether it actually ranks on its assigned page (isOffPage) and, when it does rank, the assigned page's own position (assignedPagePosition) alongside the best-ranking URL (rankingUrl). Pass ?filter=off-page to return only pages that have off-page keywords, each reduced to its off-page keywords. Bounded by tenant keyword cap (Starter: 20, Pro: 60, Team: 100).
x-notes: Returns all content pages from the keyword planner with keyword assignments
Keywords with status "queued" are pending their first weekly SERP fetch — position fields will be null
Keywords marked for removal (pending_remove) are excluded automatically
Each page includes a groupId field (null if ungrouped) and an offPageKeywords count
isOffPage = the keyword ranks on a URL other than its assigned page; rankingUrl is that URL
assignedPagePosition is the assigned page's OWN position; null means the page is not in the captured top-30
summary.offPageKeywords is the unfiltered total even when ?filter=off-page is applied

Path-routing note: this path (`/content-pages/{id}/group`) and `/content-pages/groups/{groupId}` are syntactically ambiguous in OpenAPI. At runtime the server resolves them deterministically — the literal segment `groups` always wins over the dynamic `{id}`, so `/content-pages/groups/<X>` always routes to the topic-group endpoint. No client disambiguation needed.

get.summary: Weekly gained/lost backlinks breakdown — paginated, full history since onboarding
x-notes: `weeks` is the page size (how many weekly buckets to return). `offset` shifts the window backwards from the current week. Both are unbounded — there is no server-imposed cap on history depth.

`pagination.total` is the count of calendar weeks since the tenant onboarded (`tenants.recon_completed_at`). Pre-onboarding tenants get `total: 0` and `weeks: []`. Empty intermediate weeks within the window are returned as zero-filled buckets — that is genuine signal (no gained/lost events that week), not missing data.
`summary` is always trailing-30-day, independent of `offset` / `weeks`. It is emitted on every paginated request; its values are stable across pages.

x-notes: Obtain visibilityId from GET /api/v1/ai-visibility/weekly. Runs without citations (hasCitations: false) return 404.
businesses[].supportingSources[] is authoritative per-entity citation attribution from Haiku — deduped by URL.
citedPassages counts how many passages in the AI response cite the same URL. Earliest-passage excerpt wins for citedText.
passages[] holds every passage citing a URL (ordered by passagePosition). Use to show all citation excerpts for a URL that was cited multiple times.

businesses[].reasons[] are short phrases Haiku extracted from Claude's prose about that specific business — the "why" behind the recommendation (e.g., "fast turnaround", "corporate focus"). Not tied to a specific URL.
unattributedSources[] holds URLs the AI cited that Haiku could not tie to any specific entity (general-advice blogs, ranking posts without named parties).
consideredSources[] lists URLs Claude searched but did not cite.
movement badges: `new` (cited this cycle, not last), `retained` (both cycles), `dropped` (last cycle only). Null when no prior run exists.
isTenant is resolved via ai_market_tenant_matches — a layered match (exact domain → normalized name → token subset → Jaro-Winkler → Haiku disambiguation).
Returns 404 when the visibilityId does not belong to the authenticated tenant OR has no citation data.
